name: assistance
description: How the app answers a message that is about the app or the project and not about the requirements work. One agent looks around the project (its documents, its items and the evidence behind them, its runs and settings) and around the workflow (what each of its steps does), reads what it needs of them, then answers in a few sentences and names the commands that the client may run, such as opening a document. A message about the work does not enter this workflow; it enters requirements engineering.

agent_roles.label: Assistant
agent_roles.description: Answers a question about the app or the project, looking around the project and the workflow first, and names the commands that the client may run.

tools.title: Look over the project
tools.description: Reads what the project is called, what it holds by kind of item, and how many documents it has.

tools.title: List the documents
tools.description: Lists the documents of the project with their kind, version and review status.

tools.title: Read a document
tools.description: Reads the head of one document of the project and the list of its items.

tools.title: Search the items
tools.description: Looks through the items of the project for a word or a phrase, in their key, kind and content.

tools.title: Read an item
tools.description: Reads one item of the project by its key and the fields it holds.

tools.title: Look up the evidence for an item
tools.description: Reads where an item came from: the links to other items and the quotes that carry the evidence.

uses.one: Looked up the evidence for an item
uses.other: Looked up the evidence for {count} items

tools.title: Look at the open findings
tools.description: Reads what still blocks the work: the open findings and the last validation verdict.

uses.other: Looked at the open findings {count} times

tools.title: Check the last run
tools.description: Reads how the last run of the project stands, and why it failed when it did.

tools.title: Check the run settings
tools.description: Reads the limits that the runs of this project work under, such as the steps and the cost.

tools.title: Look up a step
tools.description: Reads what a step of the requirements workflow does, from its definition.

tools.title: Check the budget
tools.description: Reads what the month has cost and how much of the budget is left.

max_reads.title: Reads for one message
max_reads.description: How many things the assistant may read of the project before it answers. Each read is one more call of the model, so it adds to the time and the cost of an answer.

message.description: The message that the assistant answers.

reads.description: How many things the assistant has read so far.
